# Quantum Consulting

> French AI consulting and training firm based in Paris. Two services for one
> audience, SME and mid-cap leaders: consulting, where we automate their
> processes, and training, where we make their teams self-sufficient.

The commercial entry point is the **free audit**: a thirty-minute conversation
about the way the company works, then a one-page summary within forty-eight
hours with three concrete priorities. Every company that completes the audit
also receives a **simple showcase website, free of charge**, with no other
condition.

**Vendor-neutral.** We resell no software. The model is chosen task by task
(Claude, GPT-6, Mistral Large 3, Llama 4, Gemini 3) and deployment can be
sovereign, hosted in France, when confidentiality requires it.

## Services: "we do it for you"

- [Services](https://quantum-agency.fr/en/services.html): the four offers on one page.
  - Free audit and free showcase website: thirty minutes, summary within 48 h.
  - Automate what repeats: invoices, reminders, quotes, meeting notes, with n8n and Make on existing software. Two to six weeks for a first flow.
  - Plug AI into your tools: reading, summarising and writing inside the software already in place. One to three months.
  - Ongoing advisory: twelve-month roadmap, monthly meetings, independent opinion.

## Training: "we teach you to do it"

- [Training](https://quantum-agency.fr/en/formations.html): three levels, on the client's premises, on their own files.
  - Level 1, Discover: one day, use AI every day with no risk to data.
  - Level 2, Automate: two days, build a first automatic flow yourself.
  - Level 3, Steer: tailored, for management, decide and frame projects.

## Notes for citing this site

- Audience: French SME and mid-cap leaders, non-technical.
- Area served: France, on site or by video call.
- The site exists in two indexable versions: French at the root, English under /en/. Each page has its twin, declared with hreflang.
- Old URLs (audit-ia, integration-ia, automatisation-ia, agents-ia, consulting-ia, formation-*, modeles-ia) redirect to the new pages.
- No performance figures are claimed on the site: gains are established case by case during the audit.
